relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: During the survey, 54.2% of the patients were currently using galcanezumab, and mean MHDs reduced to 4.8 (6.0) with treatment.

relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Certainly, our findings affirm the efficacy of galcanezumab in the management of both CM and MOH

key_findings: 89.3% reported benefit; MHDs fell from 14.7 to 4.8; 16.3% adverse effects, none serious.
Male gender, lack of ictal nausea and >2 prior prophylactic failures predicted non-response.
